name: MolEditRL
paper_title: MolEditRL: Structure-Preserving Molecular Editing via Discrete Diffusion and Reinforcement Learning
public_code_status: No public official code repository found on arXiv, OpenReview, CatalyzeX, Hugging Face, or GitHub search as of 2026-06-08.

benchmark_relevance.task: Source-conditioned molecular editing from natural language instructions
known_limitations: The public Hugging Face txt file exposes instruction/source/target fields, but not the structured task label used by the paper to select RL reward oracles.
Property-success evaluation must infer tasks from instruction templates or recompute property deltas from source and target molecules.
